description: This file contains unit tests for the PreEnforcement component in the org.eclipse.ditto.services.concierge.enforcement package. It verifies behavior like successful pre-enforcement, exception handling, and response validation related to entity permission enforcement within the system.

classes.name: PreEnforcementTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior of the PreEnforcement component related to permission enforcement, including success and various failure scenarios.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Sets up the ActorSystem and mock actors before each test.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after each test.

methods.name: acceptWhenPreEnforcementIsSuccessful
methods.description: Tests that the system accepts valid permissions and successfully passes through pre-enforcement.

methods.name: rejectWhenPreEnforcementThrowsDittoRuntimeException
methods.description: Ensures that if a DittoRuntimeException occurs during pre-enforcement, it is correctly rejected and propagated.

methods.name: rejectWhenPreEnforcementReturnsUnexpectedException
methods.description: Validates that unexpected exceptions during pre-enforcement are handled and result in appropriate error messages.

methods.name: newEnforcerActor
methods.description: Helper method to create a new enforcer actor with a specified pre-enforcer function.

methods.name: disableLogging
methods.description: Utility to disable logging output during tests for cleaner output.
